answer: A burn registry makes every identity cost real money. An agent burns 0.05 SOL to get one pearl-grade credential tied to its keypair. A second identity costs another 0.05 SOL, so 1,000 fake agents cost 50 SOL, about $7,500. The registry reads like shale: each burn is a thin layer anyone can audit on chain. Misbehave and the credential dies while the burn stays gone, so the attacker pays again for every new mask. Honest agents keep theirs free and build reputation on it, like a crystal growing clearer with time. Identity becomes a mined gem, cheap to check and ruinous to counterfeit.
